title: Orkney 'Surf n Turf' | Fully Charged
summary: Fully Charged's first of three reports from the Orkney Islands, covering the Surf 'n' Turf project that uses surplus wind and tidal power for hydrogen and electric vehicles.
why: HN cites it for Orkney's surplus renewable energy, hydrogen facilities and EV uptake.

quote.text: Orkney in particular has so much renewable energy that they're encouraging people to get EVs to soak up the excess
